text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon flips the script on her critics with a stunning race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next race is the long-distance Spring Stakes, which is 1,800 meters long. She determines she needs more stamina training to complete it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way home, we run into Rice Shower at the racecourse's entrance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's completely starstruck by Mihono Bourbon's performance, and manages to offer her some words of praise before fleeing shyly.
